description: What the one window is allowed to ask of the core plugins. Everything else this shell does goes through its own commands in `src/main.rs`, which are not plugin commands and are not gated here. The list is short on purpose: a capability is the only thing standing between a page and a plugin, so it grants what is used and is re-read when that changes. As três de janela entraram com a barra da 0.9.0, que substitui a barra de título do sistema — sem elas os três controles são desenhados, recebem o clique, e a promessa morre numa promise recusada que ninguém vê.
